critical_code_review_comments: build_guide first-guide-free logic correct (server.py:482) — uses `count_documents({user_id, guide:{$ne:null}})` to detect prior guides. Edge case: if a user manually deletes their first project before building its guide on a second project, the SECOND project counts as 'first' and is also free. Acceptable trade-off for funnel UX but worth noting.
demo.tsx uses `api()` directly (already authenticated via stored token from register step) — clean flow. Hero image is fired-and-forgotten in background — good UX, no blocking.

demo.tsx step 'locked' UI starts at index>=2 (i.e., 3rd step onward) — first two steps shown fully. Good conversion UX, but the project IS fully usable post-demo too (no real lock on backend). Confirm with PM if intentional vs front-end gating only.
